description: This file is a shell script defining the API for 'procd', a process management utility. It provides functions to open/close services and instances, send signals, check status, manage configurations, and handle triggers related to system services. The script includes detailed logic for managing service lifecycle, locking, communication, and configuration change notifications, tailored for embedded Linux environments like OpenWRT.

methods.name: procd_open_service
methods.description: Initializes a new service for process management, setting its name and optional script.

methods.name: procd_close_service
methods.description: Closes the current service context, sending the appropriate command message.

methods.name: procd_add_instance
methods.description: Adds an instance to the current service with specified parameters.

methods.name: procd_close_instance
methods.description: Finalizes the current service instance configuration.

methods.name: procd_running
methods.description: Checks if a given service or its instance(s) is currently running.

methods.name: procd_kill
methods.description: Kills a specified service instance or all instances if none specified.

methods.name: procd_send_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to a service instance, translating named signals to numeric if necessary.

methods.name: procd_status
methods.description: Provides the running status of a service and its instances.

methods.name: procd_open_data
methods.description: Opens a data namespace for configuration/state info.

methods.name: procd_set_config_changed
methods.description: Notifies the system of configuration changes for a specified package.

methods.name: procd_add_mdns_service
methods.description: Adds a mDNS service announcement with specified parameters.

methods.name: procd_add_mdns
methods.description: Creates a mDNS data object containing mDNS service information.
